name: Well-read
body:
Your devotion to the Sage has gifted you with the ability to recall many things you have read.

Prerequisite: Patron deity is a god of knowledge

Benefit: You gain a +2 divine bonus to any two Knowledge skills.

The Book of Divine Magic. Copyright 2009, 4 Winds Fantasy Gaming; Authors Connie J. Thomson and Robert W. Thomson, with Katheryn Bauer and Sean O’Connor.
